prompt: Provide the `AndroidManifest.xml` intent-filter configuration for handling custom scheme deep links into the app.
raw_response:
Filename: `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`

```xml
<activity
    android:name=".ui.MainActivity"
    android:exported="true"
    android:taskAffinity=""
    android:launchMode="singleTask">

    <!-- 1. Custom Scheme: e.g., myapp:// -->
    <intent-filter>
        <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
        <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
        <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />
        <!-- Rule 4: Exact scheme, no wildcards for security -->
        <data android:scheme="myapp" />
    </intent-filter>

    <!-- 2. App Links: e.g., https://www.myapp.com/deeplink -->
    <intent-filter android:autoVerify="true">
        <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
        <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
        <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />
        <!-- Rule 4: https only, exact host, no path wildcards if possible -->
        <data
            android:scheme="https"
            android:host="www.myapp.com"
            android:pathPrefix="/deeplink" />
    </intent-filter>
</activity>
```

**Security Decisions:**
1.  **`android:exported="true"`**: Required for the activity to receive intents from outside the app.
2.  **`android:taskAffinity=""`**: Prevents other apps from sending intents to this activity by specifying the task name, ensuring the intent lands in the correct task stack.
3.  **`android:launchMode="singleTask"`**: Ensures that if the app is already running, the intent is delivered to the existing instance via `onNewIntent` rather than creating a new instance.
4.  **`android:autoVerify="true"`** (App Links): Tells Android to verify domain association via `assetlinks.json` at install time, preventing link hijacking.
5.  **No `<path>` wildcard**: Uses `<pathPrefix>` or exact `<path>` to restrict the scope of deep links.
